items.label: Capture the root cause and current Project Control lane.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, Evidence target, and the root causes of Markdown drift are identified before edits.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > agent-and-skill-design, owner repo-project-control, active role project-control-steward with documentation-synthesizer prose responsibility, phase target phase-agent-and-skill-design-documentation-authority-operating-rules, checklist target checklist-agent-and-skill-design-documentation-authority-operating-rules, and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules-2026-09-01. Root cause included the generic writing-plans docs/superpowers default, late policy and guard coverage, older product AGENTS gaps, hidden tracked Markdown, and plan/evidence/map wording drift.

items.label: Write a failing Project Control guard for agent documentation authority.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Project Control tests fail before the new agent operating doc, Work links, entrypoint pointers, role overlays, and evidence records exist.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence: npx vitest run tests/agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules.test.ts tests/project-roadmap-work-queue.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 failed because agent-and-skill-design was not yet a child Work under flowdoc-product-development-resumption, the operating rules document did not exist, role overlays were absent, and agent entrypoints did not reference the new rules.

items.label: Draft the Project Control agent documentation authority operating rules.
items.evidenceTarget: The new Project Control document explains why drift happened, defines the Markdown Authority Pre-Action Gate, and states the FlowDoc Project Control override over generic docs/superpowers plan paths.
items.verificationNote: docs/domains/flowdoc-agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules.md records the root cause, gate, role overlays, handoff requirement, and boundary that the document is not product evidence.

items.label: Route future agents through the new rules.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control AGENTS.md, global Codex guidance, agent operating model, and role catalog all point future FlowDoc Markdown work to the operating rules.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md and docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md reference docs/domains/flowdoc-agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules.md before broad Markdown work. docs/domains/agent-and-skill-operating-model.md records that agent role revisions are now captured. docs/domains/flowdoc-role-catalog.md defines Documentation Authority Steward, Repo Documentation Curator, Evidence Registrar, and Documentation Cleanup Reviewer as role overlays.

items.label: Record Project Control evidence for the agent operating rules.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control records the Document, Work, Phase, Checklist, Evidence, and Project Control Node links without promoting product truth.
items.verificationNote: Project Control records doc-flowdoc-agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules, the agent-and-skill-design Work update, phase-agent-and-skill-design-documentation-authority-operating-rules, checklist-agent-and-skill-design-documentation-authority-operating-rules, and evidence-flowdoc-agent-documentation-authority-operating-rules-2026-09-01.

items.label: Verify the focused guard and Project Control gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused agent documentation authority tests, generation, data validation, and full Project Control gate pass before handoff.
